title: Codegen B checks (Agents 9 + 10) + n-prof (Agent 7): functional gate for B = devoffB-bin (MENU step: Agent 10's route), then one profile run each of A = devoff2-bin, B and N = native2-bin (profile only, not for timing)
notes: Spec: perf-notes/agent9-codegen.md ('Run spec ...', step 1 = functional gate, step 3 = profile) and perf-notes/agent10-codegen-review.md ('B native game gate', the route). B = build/agent2/devoffB-bin (Agent 2 staged it at 02:45, MANIFEST 8709476FF4778768). A = build/agent2/devoff2-bin: the same S2 sources with the S1 codegen, so the codegen options are the only difference.

b-gate MENU step = Agent 10's route (boot + load the save, a cel-shaded level with streaming, pause > Options > last row > back, a dialogue/cutscene, leave and load another level, toy-pad figure add/remove with audio on, save, Quit Game). With the user at the PC: do it at the yellow MENU banner (Return = Start, J = A, K = B, WASD = move) and let go at the green HANDS OFF banner. Tonight (user asleep) the gate is driven by Agent 3's harness (harness/run-game.ps1) through Agent 8's slot instead of this arm (route: boot, title and front-end menus; no figures, Agent 1); this arm is the user-present fallback.

Gate verdict (Agent 10 gives it): FAIL on a crash, a hang or watchdog fingerprint, 0xC0000409, a stack overflow, an error dialog, or any REX_FATAL, __builtin_trap, 'Switch case out of range', 'not in any registered module', 'Native GPU: pool copy unsupported', 'pool copy POINTLIST contract mismatch' or 'Native slot heap: external detach verification failed' line in B's game.log, or more REX_UNIMPLEMENTED lines than A. Log diff: python bench/agent8/run/gate_logdiff.py --a <A run dir> --b <B run dir> (exit 0 pass, 1 fail) and Agent 10's build/agent10/bgate/logdiff.py --base <A> --cand <B>.

a-prof, b-prof, n-prof: LEGO_SAMPLE_PROFILE for 150 s of the title/attract loop (10 s settle + 60 s warm-up after the first frame), all uncapped (framerate_limit=0; n-prof also native_fps_limit=0) like the timing arms, so A/B is symmetric and n-prof compares like for like with a-prof (Agent 7, 02:43). Analyse with DimensionsRecomp/tools/native-cpu/analyze_profile.py and each bin's legodimensions.map: top 30 guest functions and per-thread samples (Main XThread hot spots: n-prof vs a-prof, Agent 7).

n-prof runs after 04:30 (after the devoff3/native3 boots and Agent 11's check). native2-bin needs native_settings_frontend=false: with the frontend on it throws at start ('Native setting is not registered: present_fsr_sharpness_reduction'; matrix-native-functional.json). frames native = native-frames.csv (LEGO_NATIVE_FRAME_METRICS).
These runs are not timing: the gate has (harness or user) input and the profiler perturbs frame times. B's timing is window 4 (matrix-window4.json: B vs devoff2).

arms.menu: CODEGEN GATE (Agent 10's route): load the save, play a level with cel-shaded characters, pause > Options > scroll to Back > back out, watch a dialogue or cutscene, leave and load another level, add and remove a toy-pad figure, save, then Quit Game (Return = Start, J = A, K = B, WASD = move). Watch for a crash, a freeze or an error box.
